What I offer

Three connected services

Each project is scoped around your needs, your data, your timeline and how the evidence will be used.

Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning

  • Theory of change and results frameworks
  • Indicator development and evaluation protocols
  • Baseline, midline and endline design
  • Learning agendas and data quality systems

Digital data systems and dashboards

  • KoboToolbox, ODK and SurveyCTO
  • R Shiny, Python and Power BI dashboards
  • Automated reporting and data workflows
  • Documentation, training and technical handover

Research, analysis and reporting

  • Participatory and farmer-led research
  • Field coordination and research implementation
  • Quantitative and qualitative analysis
  • Evaluation reports, policy briefs and learning products
Every project is scoped

Every assignment is scoped with you

Sample size, coverage, fieldwork and reporting shape both the work and the budget, so every project starts with a conversation about what you need.

  • Baseline, midline and endline evaluationsDesign, sample size and fieldwork shape the work
  • Large multi-partner programmesPartners, coverage and coordination shape the work
  • Advanced statistical modellingThe data and the methods shape the work
Travel, fieldwork and other project expenses are discussed as part of the scope.Book a call to scope it
